entries.text: You’re pretty skilled.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_01

entries.text: Not many Trainers can shrug off my Pokémon’s\nattacks like that.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_02

entries.text: The same to you...Eri, was it? Your Pokémon have\nclearly spent a lot of time honing their moves.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_01

entries.text: But I’m surprised to find the boss herself out here\ndefending the gates.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_02

entries.text: Don’t you trust your grunts enough to put them\non guard duty?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_03

entries.text: Watch your mouth.\c\nI’m here because I don’t want to risk anyone else\ngetting hurt, that’s all.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_03

entries.text: What a benevolent boss. Now, if you want to\nget on with our battle, I’m all ready on my side![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_04

entries.text: Say something
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_select_01

entries.text: Get a closer look
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_select_02

entries.text: Who are you?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! There you are![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_05

entries.text: I started talking to this girl since she looked like\nshe was with Team Star...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_06

entries.text: then she and her Pokémon came at me without\nwarning! We were just battling it out.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_07

entries.text: Riri! I knew you’d be out here![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_08

entries.text: Carmen![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_05

entries.text: Are you OK? You’re not hurt, are you?![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_01

entries.text: I’m fine, honestly! Now get away from here—it’s\nnot safe![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_06

entries.text: I’ll take over guarding the base, Riri! You should\nget back inside![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_02

entries.text: No. I won’t back down... I can’t![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_07

entries.text: Oh, Riri! You need to stop this![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_03

entries.text: Until the big boss comes back, I have to protect\nall of you in the Caph Squad...\c\nAnd everyone else in Team Star, too.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_08

entries.text: That’s why you should get back to the base and\nrest up—even just for a little bit![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_04

entries.text: As the boss of this squad, I...I just can’t.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_09

entries.text: Riri, please! I’m your friend! Listen to what\nI’m saying![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_05

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_10

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_06

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_09

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_07

entries.text: Fine...I’ll go.\c\nI’m sorry, Carmen![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_11

entries.text: Hey, that’s no way to sign off! Let me hear a\n“hasta la vistar!” from you, nice and loud![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_08

entries.text: H-hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_kakutouboss_12

entries.text: I’m your opponent now, you two! Come on—I’ll\ntake you both down![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_09

entries.text: My Pokémon and I are actually running on empty\nafter that last battle.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_11

entries.text: Sorry to spring this on you, but do you think you\ncould handle this grunt alone?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_12

entries.text: Come on, don’t be like that! It’s not like you to\nhang me out to dry...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_13

entries.text: Thanks. I’ll be cheering you on from the sidelines![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_nelke_14

entries.text: I’ll protect Riri with everything I have. You ready\nto battle?[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_10

entries.text: I’m so ready!
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_select_03

entries.text: Hold on!
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_select_04

entries.text: Just hurry up and leave, then! I’m not budging\nan inch from here.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_11

entries.text: Then here I come![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_12

entries.text: Even if all I did was buy Riri a bit of time,\nthat’s fine.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_13

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_select_05

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_select_06

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_14

entries.text: [EMPTY 50]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_15

entries.text: My job here is done, so I’ll head back inside![VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_16

entries.text: Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_010_sitappa_17
